rv.q: Its concluding part, Echo and Narcissus, is a short work, exquisitely formed and performed. It is preceded on this programme by a replay of Brandstrup’s 2014 dance film Leda and the Swan and a live recital of Britten’s Six Metamorphoses after Ovid for oboe, played by Judy Proctor.
Kim Brandstrup concludes his Grecian trilogy with a brilliantly unsettling dive through the looking glass
